prompt: A brush lettering quote poster design in portrait orientation. The entire background is a flat solid black surface with a few small scattered white dots. All lettering is pure white with slightly rough dry-marker edges. The poster contains exactly six words arranged as four stacked lines that form one tight block centered on the canvas; the block occupies the middle three quarters of the width and leaves wide empty black margins on all four sides. The block tilts so each line rises toward the right, and neighbouring lines sit close together. Line one, at the top, reads "KEEP GOING" as two words side by side on one line in large thick round brush-marker capitals with a bouncy uneven baseline. Line two reads "you are" as two words side by side on one line in smaller thick round brush-marker lowercase letters. Line three reads "ALMOST" in very large thick round brush-marker capitals with a bouncy uneven baseline. Line four, at the bottom, reads "THERE" in the same thick round brush-marker capitals as line one. One word is clearly the largest, and the small words tuck in tightly. The only text in the image is these six words, each appearing once. The image uses only pure white and pure black, solid white strokes on a clean black background.
